description: Builds an internal one-page guide with twelve tiles (office and consumables, IT hardware, software and subscriptions, furniture, workwear and safety, maintenance and spare parts, production material, services and consultants, marketing and print, travel, events and catering, everything else). Each tile has examples, the right channel (catalogue, call-off from a framework agreement, request to procurement or IT, travel portal, own purchase up to the small-order limit), the rule and the owner. An optional tiles list replaces the defaults (tile, includes, where, supplier, rule, owner) and marks gaps. A question such as "where do I order toner?" returns the matching tile. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

question.description: Optional question, for example "Where do I order toner?".

small_limit.description: Small-order limit in euros up to which employees may order without quotes. Default 1000.

tiles.description: Optional own tiles: tile, includes (examples), where (channel), supplier, rule, owner. German column names work too.

name: build_buying_tiles
title: Buying tiles: an internal page with twelve tiles that tells employees where to order what, with the right channel per tile and an answer to a single question
